title: Universal weak Gaussian profile for global isothermal fluid weak solutions with bounded rescaled pseudo-energy and finite dissipation
author: Rémi Carles; Kleber Carrapatoso; Matthieu Hillairet
work: Rigidity results in generalized isothermal fluids
source_version: Annales Henri Lebesgue 1 (2018), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/ahl.2

primary_locator.required_core: complete author global weak-solution definition, rescaled pseudo-energy/dissipation, ODE scale, slow-time tightness, vanishing nonlinear stresses and stationary Fokker-Planck identification

difficulty_reason: The author turns compressible dispersive dynamics into a rescaled Fokker–Planck limit and removes nonlinear transport, capillarity and viscosity stresses through entropy tightness and a slow-time compactness argument. This universal asymptotic rigidity mechanism exceeds ordinary qualifying PDE.
